StudyHub

Helping students find people to study with.

Kotlin · Android · Kotlin/JS · UML

View source on GitHub ↗

The project

StudyHub is a student-built study-group application intended for Android phones, with a web component. It is our main Introduction to Software Engineering course project.

My contribution

I designed the client-server architecture, including a Kotlin/JS web component using KVision and Kobweb. I document code and use UML to visualize how the system fits together, helping teammates understand and extend it.

Current status

Development is ongoing. My approximately eight hours of weekly work outside class covers this course and its project together.
